# Minimal call — scoring rubric (fixture)

Twelve dimensions, 100 points.

### Global Automatic Score Caps

Before scoring, check these conditions:

| Condition | Cap |
|---|---|
| Next call NOT booked live during the call | 0/5 on D10 (non-recoverable) |
| No connection to long-term vision | Max 10/15 on D3 |
| Coach speaks >75% of the call | Max 75 total |

### Dimension 1 — Check-In & Connection (10 pts)

| Score | Criteria |
|---|---|
| **10/10 — Elite** | Great check-in. |
| **0/10 — Fail** | Skips check-in. |

### Dimension 2 — Diagnostics Review (10 pts)

| Score | Criteria |
|---|---|
| **10/10 — Elite** | Great review. |

### Dimension 3 — Program Focus + Vision (15 pts)

| Score | Criteria |
|---|---|
| **15/15 — Elite** | Great vision. |

### Dimension 4 — Movement Coaching Quality (15 pts) — Optional

> **Optional dimension — disable when no movement coaching occurred.**

| Score | Criteria |
|---|---|
| **15/15 — Elite** | Great coaching. |

| Score | Criteria |
|---|---|
| **10/10 — Elite** | Great adjustments. |

|---|---|
| **10/10 — Elite** | Great steps. |

---

## Scoring Bands Reference

| Band | Score | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **ELITE** | 90–100 | Exceptional. |
| **STRONG** | 80–89 | Good call. |
| **INCONSISTENT** | 70–79 | Flat. |
| **AT RISK** | 60–69 | Weak. |
| **FAIL** | <60 | Missing core elements. |
